omar: quick heads-up: rack-12 (eu-west) showing noisy-neighbor pattern since 02:04 UTC — NVMe write bursts + elevated host cpu steal. 99p gen latency climbed ~120ms -> ~1.8s, some client timeouts.
tia: confirmed. router egress queue depth spiked; top writers in last 10m are tenant-349 and tenant-902. looks like parallel dataset ingests.
kelly: mitigation plan: canary 5% fallback to warm-reserve, apply per-tenant shaping for tenant-349 to 70Mbps, lower spillback_window to 40s. avoid migrating unless shaping fails. if warm-reserve 99p >700ms rollback.
infra-bot: [ACTION] 02:10 UTC fallback 5% applied to slice-dedicated-12 by kelly; telemetry tag=nn-noise-5999998888. 99p fell to ~240ms within 80s. top_writers: ["tenant-349","tenant-902","tenant-118"] avg_iops [5300,3200,700].
omar: good. open INF-9009 to track shaping, telemetry, and follow-up quarantine rule (auto-quarantine after 3 spikes in 6h). capture iostat + router logs in the ticket.
tia: shaping applied to tenant-349 (70Mbps). monitoring 10m window before scaling fallback.
kelly: cost note: warm-reserve delta ~+$420/hr at current load. ops approves up to 2h. if >2h inform finance.
infra-bot: 02:18 UTC canary stable; 99p ~220ms, error rate stable. will monitor for 30m.
omar: thanks team. will post postmortem draft in INF-9009 after stabilization. :thumbsup:
